proposed_stop_rules: model identifier mismatch in any response: stop
refusals above 5% after the first 50 requests: stop and report
any capture refused by the safety checks (credential-shaped text): stop
next request would exceed the request cap or the reserved budget: stop
any network attempt to a destination other than the allowed one: stop
